title: Every need's backups, in the source map's order (part c2)
why: decisions/0163's source map: ours first, then outside free before paid, then the planned fallback (Jason, 2026-11-17: "go ahead and do the full build so I only approve once"). 1. W2 re-read websites: when a listing's website doesn't load, Common Crawl's newest copy (crawler 2.11.0); a copy within 90 days sends the website to Review instead of taking it off, and fills only an empty description, dated. 2. W3 sources: a page that won't load is read from Common Crawl's copy before Tavily Extract (free before paid; at most 12 copies a run). 3. W2 missing phone: our copies of the NPI Registry (same street number and ZIP, the name agreeing) and Recreation.gov (same name and ZIP) are sent with the identity job; the worker looks outside only for what's still missing (2.12.0). 4. W2 map points: a Census geocoder that doesn't answer makes the batch wait and the task report held, not failed. 5. W2 still open: listings our copies or their website flag as possibly closed go first to the Google check. 6. W1 official places: a Wikidata failure sends the job round again (partial) instead of finishing it on OpenStreetMap alone. 7. W8 Find it: our OpenStreetMap copy (open_places) before a live Overpass ask. 8. Site email: Bluehost SMTP, then Amazon SES (the site's own SesMail, personal account, send.traversence.com, only when SES is live), each switch logged; when both fail the SMTP error stands as before. A failed QUIT after the server accepted the message no longer counts as a failure (so the backup can't send it twice). 9. Weather: when there's no forecast to show, the place's guide shows a link to the National Weather Service's forecast instead of hiding the card. 10. W10 live events: a failed check is tried again the next day; found-nothing still waits the full refresh. 11. The pre-flight and Start the system (Jason's report, 17:44 UTC, W1 red): the switch-on check's OpenStreetMap line held W1 while every Overpass server is held and our Geofabrik copy isn't loaded, though loading it is W1's own task (t:osm, after W1): a deadlock. The line is now green also when the pre-flight's Geofabrik line works, or when "Places by kind and town" answers from a backup (Overture). 12. A workflow's answer starts with what holds it ("What holds it: …") and lists every red gate line, not only the first; answers are no longer cut at 600 characters. Not built: stock photos' order (decisions/0143 interleaves the sources on purpose; changing it needs Jason's OK), menus (no menu reader exists yet), W6 heritage's Wikimedia and National Park Service steps, Find it's Tavily → Brave step, AZ Corporation Commission and NM Secretary of State readers, W14. No migration; no new endpoint.

items: No new fatal errors in the logs
